howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Specify pages to remove
howto.text: Comma-separated list and/or ranges, e.g. '2, 5, 10-12'. The remaining pages keep their relative order.

howto.name: Download the trimmed PDF
howto.text: Click Delete. PrivaTools returns a PDF with those pages removed; bookmarks pointing to deleted pages are rewritten to the next valid page.

faq.q: What happens to bookmarks pointing to deleted pages?
faq.a: They're either dropped or rewritten to the nearest remaining page, depending on outline structure. The Bookmarks tool can be used afterwards to clean them up.
Yes — use ranges like '5-12'. Mix single pages and ranges freely.
Visible page numbers (added with the Page Numbers tool) stay as they were rendered. The internal page indices reflect the new order.
